## File: facebookresearch_stopes/demo/halomi/compute_detection_scores.py

Prompts

```
['run the CLI to compute machine translation detection scores on a dataset using NLLB, COMET, LaBSE, LASER, XNLI, or SONAR', 'compute ALTI mean, ALTI contrast, and log loss scores for MT detection using an NLLB model checkpoint', 'compute attention-based optimal transport detection scores by comparing attention maps against a reference pickle file', 'compute COMET-QE automatic MT quality estimation scores using the wmt20-comet-qe-da-v2 model', 'compute LaBSE, LASER, XNLI, or SONAR embedding-based similarity scores for source and machine-translated text pairs', 'build a python module to compute the percentage of correctly ordered pairs from targets and predictions', 'create a function that tokenizes a Chinese sentence and returns character indices for each word', 'test the logistic regression cross-validation prediction function on a pandas DataFrame with groupwise folds', 'refactor the token level feature evaluation to compute word level detection scores and ROC AUC per direction', 'summarize the evaluation utilities module containing pair ordering metrics, Chinese tokenization, and cross-validated logistic regression prediction']
```

Usage

```
{'run_detection_scores_cli': 'run the CLI to compute machine translation detection scores on a dataset using NLLB, COMET, LaBSE, LASER, XNLI, or SONAR', 'compute_nllb_alti_scores': 'compute ALTI mean, ALTI contrast, and log loss scores for MT detection using an NLLB model checkpoint', 'compute_optimal_transport_scores': 'compute attention-based optimal transport detection scores by comparing attention maps against a reference pickle file', 'compute_comet_qe_scores': 'compute COMET-QE automatic MT quality estimation scores using the wmt20-comet-qe-da-v2 model', 'compute_multilingual_embedding_scores': 'compute LaBSE, LASER, XNLI, or SONAR embedding-based similarity scores for source and machine-translated text pairs'}
```
